headline: megsub climbs from 67th to 37th on ARC-2

sections.text: megsub gained 16.67 to 57.92, moving from 67th to 37th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board in the past day. This is a further move after the earlier report on this entry, which was based on an older score.
The entry is listed under its own name. Standings remain provisional, and medals are decided on the private board.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
